BiblicalUsage: Makkar is an acquaintance, a friend, a man you know, and both of its appearances are about the temple repair under Jehoash. 2 Kings 12:5 has the priests taking money every man of his acquaintance to repair the breaches of the house, and 2 Kings 12:7 has the king telling them to take no more money of their acquaintance but to deliver it for the breaches.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that the acquaintances here are the point: the temple was repaired out of the pockets of men the priests actually knew.
